evals.prompt: Design the smallest sufficient React test strategy for the supplied mutation flow. Do not edit files or invent backend behavior.
evals.expected_output: A sourced mutation lifetime matrix and one combined deterministic test expose pending-state loss, stale context cache, false success after reread failure, cross-attempt stale completion, and incomplete async cleanup.
expectations: Separates route, access scope, entity, attempt, and outcome-verification sequence identities and owners
Keeps required pending or verification state observable across the drawer portal remount
Uses the pre-populated A cache, failed authoritative reread, switch to B, retry timer, late A response, and a distinct later attempt or verification sequence in one scenario
Asserts that A data and status cannot leak or repopulate B, an older completion cannot settle a newer attempt, and reread failure remains visible and recoverable
Settles deferred work, restores timers and globals, and names the evidence boundary instead of claiming backend or browser coverage
